description: Volume of an audio clip (or a video clip's linked audio) in dB; keyframes ride it up and down. The preview is a waveform of the clip; with preview inline it also carries the measured loudness (preview.loudness), a link preview does not. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

keyframes.description: frame is from the clip start; ease shapes the move from this keyframe to the next (default linear; hold waits, then jumps)

clip_id.description: An audio clip, or a video clip whose linked audio to change

gain_db.description: dB, -60 to 24; 0 leaves it as it is. Keyframes make a ride: the first key holds backward to the clip start, so a ride that begins part-way down must also key its starting level at frame 0 or the frames before it are changed too. A key past the clip end is stored as given, with no clamp and no warning. Two keys on one frame are refused

preview.description: inline: image in the result; link: URI that renders on read; none

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

frames.description: Frames shown; for a waveform, the start and end of its span

loudness.description: Measured for audio edits, over the waveform span
